identityRecipe: Hash the versioned production TokenTemplate payload excluding id. Production drops research-only isCard/commander fields; those become runtime origin properties.

oracle.name: Flurry of Horns
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 2/3 red Minotaur creature tokens with haste.
oracle.flavor_text: A minotaur does not distinguish between human, satyr, and triton. They are all meat.

oracle.name: Allied Reinforcements
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 2/2 white Knight Ally creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: "Our formation was scattered after Sea Gate fell. If you're fighting the Eldrazi, consider us your newest recruits."

oracle.name: Call to the Feast
oracle.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 white Vampire creature tokens with lifelink.
oracle.flavor_text: By the law of church and crown, vampires feed only on the blood of the guilty—those declared heretics, rebels, or enemies of war.

oracle.name: Spectral Procession
oracle.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
oracle.flavor_text:
"I need never remember my past associates, my victims, my mistakes. Innistrad preserves them all for me."
—Sorin Markov

oracle.name: Sprout
oracle.oracle_text: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
oracle.flavor_text: Centuries of temporal strife had stripped Dominaria of its natural defenses, but nature fought back with armies constructed of little more than grime and sunlight.

oracle.name: Talrand's Invocation
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 2/2 blue Drake creature tokens with flying.
oracle.flavor_text: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

oracle.name: Captain's Call
oracle.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Argivia's walls may run on powerstones, but its real power comes from its people."
—King Darien XLVIII

oracle.name: Knight Watch
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 2/2 white Knight creature tokens with vigilance.
oracle.flavor_text:
"We lost respect after the battle for Barbu Rooftop. Send the troops to mingle respectfully with the citizens."
—Commander Yaszen of Boros

oracle.name: Raise the Alarm
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

oracle.name: Revel of the Fallen God
oracle.oracle_text: Create four 2/2 red and green Satyr creature tokens with haste.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Xenagos has fallen, and the world grows dark without him. What can ever fill that darkness but our rage?"
—Guruthes, disciple of Xenagos

oracle.name: Queen's Commission
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 white Vampire creature tokens with lifelink.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Let the blood of the impure flow through you. Only the blessings of the golden city will purge its acrid taste from your mouth."
—High Marshal Arguel

oracle.name: Take Up Arms
oracle.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Many scales make the skin of a dragon."
—Abzan wisdom

oracle.name: Call the Cavalry
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 2/2 white Knight creature tokens with vigilance.
oracle.flavor_text: Benalish citizens born under the same constellations share a star-clan. Their loyalty to one another interlaces the Seven Houses.

oracle.name: Spore Swarm
oracle.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: As the irrepressible power of a dormant Multani courses through Yavimaya, the forest passes judgment on travelers and natives alike. Only the fungus prospers.

oracle.name: Inkling Summoning
oracle.oracle_text: Create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Think of an insult so vicious, so vulgar, that you hesitate to speak it aloud. The strongest, most aggressive inklings are born from such scorn."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

oracle.name: Goblin Rally
oracle.oracle_text: Create four 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: You don't so much hire goblins as put ideas in their heads.

oracle.name: Krenko's Command
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: Krenko's hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.

oracle.name: Spirit Summoning
oracle.oracle_text: Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Books are fantastic, but if you're really curious about the distant past, why not ask someone who was there?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

oracle.name: Hordeling Outburst
oracle.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

oracle.name: Midnight Haunting
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
oracle.flavor_text: The path back to the world of the living is murky and bewildering. A geist may not even realize that it's terrifying its own loved ones.

oracle.name: Join the Ranks
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 white Soldier Ally creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: Expeditionary houses are notorious for their rivalries. But when adventurers meet in the wilderness, the instinct for mutual survival outweighs petty grudges.

oracle.name: Icatian Town
oracle.oracle_text: Create four 1/1 white Citizen creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: Icatia's once peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from orcs and goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

oracle.name: Release the Dogs
oracle.oracle_text: Create four 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

oracle.name: Hive Stirrings
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 colorless Sliver creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: Sliver young are sorted into clutches according to their potential and their future role. Human scholars can only guess how those are determined.

oracle.name: Dragon Fodder
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: Gnorl and Vurg knew all too well how much dragons liked to eat goblins, but they had a dream that could not be dampened: they were going to be the first goblins to eat a dragon.

oracle.name: Sworn Companions
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens with lifelink.
oracle.flavor_text:
"The trouble with youths these days is that, in outright defiance of their elders, they refuse to be bought."
—Karlov of the Ghost Council

oracle.name: Call of the Conclave
oracle.oracle_text: Create a 3/3 green Centaur creature token.
oracle.flavor_text: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

oracle.name: Ral's Reinforcements
oracle.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 blue and red Elemental creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text: "Good thing maintenance never got around to decatalyzing the bithermic plasma displacement conduits!"

oracle.name: Hop to It
oracle.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Finding a hidden patch of glowberries is almost as joyful as eating them. Almost."
—Ms. Bumbleflower

oracle.name: Advent of the Wurm
oracle.oracle_text: Create a 5/5 green Wurm creature token with trample.
oracle.flavor_text: The consciousness of Mat'Selesnya does not always spread in peaceful ways.

oracle.name: Elemental Summoning
oracle.oracle_text: Create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
oracle.flavor_text:
"You've made a splash. Now show me a torrent."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean
